model.name: Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation.

notes.body:
Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation. Enalaprilat is an inhibitor of ACE, so it inhibits conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II.
components: renin, angiotensinogen, angiotensin I, angiotensin II, ACE, aldosterone, systolic and diastolic blood pressure
angiotensin II raises the blood pressure (vasoconstriction) and the aldosterone secretion
negative feedback loop: angiotensin II inhibits the secretion of renin
angiotensin I is converted by ACE or cleared by other peptidases
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

parameter.name: maximum increase of the renin secretion without angiotensin II

body.p: Angiotensin II inhibits the renin secretion through its AT1 receptors on the juxtaglomerular cells (short-loop feedback): without angiotensin II the secretion is 1 + RENSEC_ang2_E times the one of the reference. The secretion follows angiotensin II with a delay (ang2_feedback).
The value of RENSEC_ang2_E is the result of the fit PD_20261020_125416__5ce99, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: half-life of the delay of the renin feedback

body.p: The renin secretion responds to a change of angiotensin II with a delay of this half-life (the signalling of the AT1 receptors and the release of renin from its granules), while angiotensin II itself has a half-life of about 0.5 min.
The value of RENSEC_ang2_t is the result of the fit PD_20261020_125416__5ce99, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: angiotensin II of the renin feedback

body.p: Angiotensin II which the renin secretion senses, a first order delay of angiotensin II with the half-life RENSEC_ang2_t.
Clearance of angiotensin I by ACE and the other peptidases, a half-life of 0.5 min in 5 l plasma.

parameter.name: rate angiotensinogen to angiotensin I conversion (renin)
fraction of angiotensin I converted by ACE

body.p: Fraction of the angiotensin I which ACE converts to angiotensin II in the reference state, the rest is cleared by other peptidases (neprilysin, aminopeptidases). Not fitted: the value of the same RAAS model fitted to the angiotensin I and II data of ramipril (0.154); the three curves of angiotensin I and II of the enalapril studies do not identify it.

parameter.name: rate angiotensin I to angiotensin II conversion (ACE)

body.p: Clearance of aldosterone, a half-life of 20 min in 5 l plasma.
Aldosterone secretion in the steady state of the reference.

parameter.name: fraction of the aldosterone secretion driven by angiotensin II

body.p: Angiotensin II stimulates the aldosterone secretion through AT1 receptors of the zona glomerulosa; the rest of the secretion (potassium, ACTH) does not depend on it. Not fitted: the value of the same RAAS model fitted to the aldosterone data of ramipril (0.664); the training data of enalapril have no aldosterone.

parameter.name: EC50 of the ACE inhibition by enalaprilat

body.p: Concentration of enalaprilat in the plasma for half of the inhibition of the plasma ACE activity; the in vivo IC50 is 1.7-12.8 ng/ml {Hockings1986}, 22.9 +- 6.5 nM in young subjects {MacDonald1993}, the in vitro IC50 of enalaprilat about 1 nM.
The value of ANG1ANG2_EC50_eat is the result of the fit PD_20261020_125416__5ce99, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: effect of angiotensin II on blood pressure [-]

body.p: Relative change of the blood pressure per relative change of angiotensin II, the vasoconstriction through AT1 receptors: without angiotensin II the pressure falls by BP_ang2_fe of its reference.
The value of BP_ang2_fe is the result of the fit PD_20261020_125416__5ce99, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
